posts.title: Why your vehicle deserves a proper cover
posts.lead: Sun, dust, bird droppings and hail are quietly ageing your car every single day.
body: A good cover is one of the cheapest ways to protect what is often your second most expensive purchase. Strong sun fades paint and cracks dashboards. Dust and tree sap bake onto the body. Hail and falling branches leave dents that cost far more than a cover ever will.

A custom-fit cover, cut to your exact vehicle, stays put in the wind and does not rub the paint. If you park outside all year, choose a heavy-duty waterproof fabric. If you park in a compound with a roof, a lighter dust cover is enough.
For several vehicles in one place, a car park shade may be the better investment: one structure protects every bay, with no covering and uncovering each day.

posts.title: How to choose the right tent for a wedding or event
posts.lead: The right tent is about more than size. Here is what to check before you order.
body: Start with the guest list. As a rough guide, a seated event needs about one square metre per guest, and more if you want a dance floor, buffet tables or a stage.

Think about the ground. A tent on grass, murram or concrete is anchored differently, so tell us the surface when you order. Consider the weather too: a good tent keeps guests dry in rain and cool in strong sun.
Finally, plan the extras: side walls, flooring, lighting and entrances. Tell us your ideas and we will make the tent to fit them.

posts.title: Canvas or PVC: which material should you choose?
posts.lead: Both are tough. They just suit different jobs.
body: Canvas is breathable, so it stays cooler inside on hot days. It is a traditional choice for camping, relief and long-term shelter, and it can be treated to resist water.
PVC is fully waterproof and easy to wipe clean, which makes it ideal for truck covers, canopies, hospital tents and anywhere that needs to stay dry and hygienic.
Not sure which fits? Tell us what the structure is for and where it will stand, and we will recommend the right fabric.
